rationale: Java permits Descendant.Nested to extend InnerBase.Deep where InnerBase is inherited via Descendant->Middle->Ancestor. javac/javap identify its superclass as Ancestor$InnerBase$Deep, not the unrelated Decoy$InnerBase$Deep. The original inheritedMemberOwner guard checks only immediate declaringType, misses the inherited qualifier chain and downgrades explicit overrides to first-parent-guess. Require exact-in-file evidence for both overridden members, and never derive an override from the decoy method.
